mostWorthwhile.text: Building a shared warning from a call and memory was most worthwhile: it made clear how a learned association can turn sound into useful information for another animal.

leastWorthwhile.text: Creating attention and then fear felt comparatively thin; the results were plausible but too brief to say much about how either works.

surprise.text: The final social group was broader than the refuge response I expected, and its acknowledgement of conflict complicated the cooperative outcome.
